about: Formal taxonomy/ontology of EvalGlass as portrayed by its website + documentation, built for later cross-checking and reconciliation against the EvalGlass/evalglass-core framework repo. Every entity is verification:asserted|conceptual — NOT yet verified against code.

Layer.desc: A top-level architectural layer of the product.

Actor.desc: A human or machine role that participates in the system.

Port.desc: A typed effect-seam (typing.Protocol). Exactly six; the lane contract.

Component.desc: A code/runtime unit. kind ∈ {engine-fn, protocol, harness-unit, adapter, surface, service, evaluator}.

Contract.desc: A typed in-memory data structure (dataclass / schema) passed between components.

Artifact.desc: An on-disk file or persisted output the system reads or writes.

Enum.desc: A closed enumeration the engine speaks.

EnumValue.desc: A single member of a closed enumeration.

Concept.desc: A design/trust primitive that is not a single code symbol.

Invariant.desc: A testable guarantee or rule the system maintains.

Extension.desc: An optional, opt-in, deletable lane that attaches via a Port.

ADR.desc: An architecture decision record the docs cite as authority.

implements.desc: concrete adapter of a port protocol

attachesVia.desc: the port a lane plugs into

entities.label: CI
entities.definition: The continuous-integration runner that acts on ci_should_fail / the exit code only.

entities.label: Coding Agent
entities.definition: The AI coding agent (Claude Code / Codex) that operates EvalGlass as a typist and reader.

entities.label: Developer
entities.definition: The human building the AI/agentic application and the only party that can grant gating authority.

entities.label: Host
entities.definition: The repo/project that owns the truth: datasets, thresholds, calibration, approvals.

entities.label: Reviewer
entities.definition: The human who signs a validation_record or calibration, converting evidence into authority.

entities.label: Vendored Runtime
entities.definition: The managed code under evals/_evalglass/ that actually runs the evaluation and decides the verdict.

entities.label: ADR 0005 — Config / authority-safe defaults
entities.definition: An under-specified metric is forced to informational+proposed by the Config Loader.

entities.label: ADR 0008 — Verdict Engine
entities.definition: The single decide_verdict path and precedence; VerdictPayload re-derivation.

entities.label: ADR 0009 — Provenance fingerprint
entities.definition: Ten dimensions, six gating; fail-closed comparability.

entities.label: ADR 0021 — Evidence approval
entities.definition: Synthetic forced proposed; self-approval forbidden.

entities.label: ADR 0025 — Evidence approval (cont.)
entities.definition: Annotation validation_record + benchmark self-approval rules.

entities.label: authority.json
entities.definition: Host-owned typed root of gating authority; empty on fresh install; no agent command can modify it.

entities.label: baselines/main.json
entities.definition: Explicitly promoted baseline with gating-dimension fingerprints; written only by baseline update.

entities.label: CI workflow file
entities.definition: Scaffolded GitHub Actions workflow that bundles the vendored runtime and exits on ci_should_fail; adds no verdict logic.

entities.label: datasets/ (JSONL gold)
entities.definition: Host-owned examples with proposed/validated status backing reference metrics.

entities.label: evalglass.yaml
entities.definition: Host-owned config parsed into RuntimeConfig; authority-safe by construction.

entities.label: ExtensionLane metadata
entities.definition: Declarative manifest (name, port, module, deletion_rule, prerequisites); no code imported until LaneRegistry.resolve().

entities.label: Honesty Charter
entities.definition: Public covenant (dated 2 Jun 2026) refusing fabricated trust signals; binds the site to the engine's standard.

entities.label: report.md / CI annotations
entities.definition: Human-readable and GitHub-annotation renderings of the Scorecard; never authoritative.

entities.label: runrecord.json
entities.definition: The complete reproducible record persisted alongside the scorecard.

entities.label: scorecard.json
entities.definition: The sole authoritative output; all renderings derive from it without recomputing the verdict.

entities.label: traces/ (exported behavior)
entities.definition: Host-owned exported OTel/OpenInference/local JSON traces normalized via connect; no SDK/network on the required path.

entities.label: vendor-manifest.json + evalglass.lock
entities.definition: Managed-file registry (content/tree hashes) + version lock enabling safe, auditable revendor and host-patch detection.

entities.label: evals/_evalglass/ (vendored runtime)
entities.definition: The sealed managed Core+Harness+adapters under version control; deletion-invariant; identical across runtimes.

entities.label: FakeJudgeModel
entities.definition: The deterministic judge on the required path — no keys, no network.

entities.label: Filesystem ResultStore
entities.definition: Persists scorecard.json / runrecord.json to disk.

entities.label: LocalJsonl DatasetStore
entities.definition: Reads host-owned JSONL gold datasets at the edge.

entities.label: LocalJsonlTraceSource
entities.definition: Reads host-owned exported traces from local JSONL at the edge.

entities.label: Markdown / Terminal / CI-annotation sinks
entities.definition: Render the Scorecard without recomputing the verdict.

entities.label: OpenConventionTraceSource
entities.definition: Maps the open-convention (OpenTelemetry/OpenInference) exported-trace shape to Examples.

entities.label: Subprocess TaskRunner
entities.definition: Replays the subject app via subprocess to produce outputs.

entities.label: aggregate
entities.definition: Reduces only scored+valid Scores; excluded statuses counted but excluded from the math; empty metric is null; excluded_count>0 blocks an active gate.

entities.label: Claude Code plugin
entities.definition: Primary agent-facing operator surface exposing the /evalglass verbs; scaffolds and runs, grants no authority.

entities.label: Codex second runtime (packaging)
entities.definition: Same canonical skills tree via a thin .codex-plugin manifest; single-source packaging and runtime independence proven (verdicts byte-identical). The runtime support is real now; the PUBLIC marketplace listing is a separate, not-yet-published step — see comp.public-codex-listing.

entities.label: Config Loader
entities.definition: Parses evalglass.yaml into typed RuntimeConfig; fail-closed; authority-safe defaults force an under-specified metric to informational+proposed.

entities.label: decide_verdict / Verdict Engine
entities.definition: The single verdict path turning authority + measurement into one of informational/pass/fail/blocked; precedence blocked > fail > pass > informational.

entities.label: Direct vendoring CLI
entities.definition: Plugin-optional install/run path (python -m _evalglass.harness.cli run) producing byte-identical artifacts.

entities.label: exact-match evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: compares output to host gold for exact equality.

entities.label: field-presence evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: required-field presence on the output.

entities.label: judge-score evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: turns judge evidence into a score (informational until calibrated).

entities.label: set-overlap evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: set overlap of output vs gold.

entities.label: structural-shape evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: structural conformance of the output.

entities.label: trajectory-shape evaluator
entities.definition: Built-in: inspects the agent trajectory/trace shape.

entities.label: Evaluator protocol
entities.definition: Produces Score/ScoreBatch from Example+EvidenceBundle. Returns non_evaluable, never 0.0.

entities.label: Exit Mapper
entities.definition: Fixed lookup verdict→exit class: 0 (pass/informational), 1 (fail/blocked), 2 (infrastructure error only). Never fabricates a verdict.

entities.label: Exported-trace connector
entities.definition: Maps exported OpenTelemetry / OpenInference / local JSON traces to Examples at the edge; no SDK, no network on the required path. The shipped "now" connector.

entities.label: fingerprint_dimension
entities.definition: Computes the ten provenance dimension hashes (six gating); fail-closed comparability (absent dimension = changed).

entities.label: Harness CLI (argparse)
entities.definition: Two commands (run, baseline update); maps the core verdict to an exit class; IO failure becomes an infrastructure error, never a quality verdict.

entities.label: EvalGlass Skill / Installer
entities.definition: discover/plan/install/revendor; vendors the managed runtime with manifest+lock; scaffolds proposed assets; host-patch guard.

entities.label: Judge Collection & Calibration
entities.definition: Policy-aware judge evidence collection; FakeJudgeModel is the deterministic required path; a host CalibrationRecord lifts a judge to gating-eligible.

entities.label: Extension Lanes framework / LaneRegistry
entities.definition: Metadata-only, lazy-imported lane system attaching via the six ports; lanes return LaneResult + evidence only. The framework surface ships now; individual convenience lanes keep their own statuses.

entities.label: Per-source-function score mapping
entities.definition: Future grouping of scores back to the producing call site; needs trace↔call-site correlation, deliberately not yet invented. The per-call --by-call view ships now and is NOT per-function grouping.

entities.label: Public Codex marketplace listing
entities.definition: The maintainer publication step (cross-repo sync PR + acceptance probe). NOT yet published — the /docs/codex page states a public Codex listing is not yet available.

entities.label: Report Sinks
entities.definition: Markdown/Terminal/CiAnnotation renderings of the immutable Scorecard; verdict read from scorecard.verdict, never recomputed; sinks do no I/O.

entities.label: resolve_authority
entities.definition: Fail-closed three-stage authority ladder (resolve_authority(AuthorityInputs) → ResolvedAuthority) emitting typed reason codes; the data-policy hard gate accepts only {permitted, redacted}.

entities.label: run_evaluation
entities.definition: Core composition entry point; validates scores, resolves comparability then authority, calls decide_verdict exactly once, packs the RunRecord.

entities.label: Runner (composition root)
entities.definition: Converges the six ports into one Example spine (TraceEnvelope→EvalUnit→Example); enforces the trust properties; calls run_evaluation exactly once with typed Examples only.

entities.label: Site & docs lead the code
entities.definition: Future-facing capability is allowed only when badged and never shown executing; the badge and the example must agree.

entities.label: Capability is not authority
entities.definition: A feature being present never means a run gates on it; only a host-owned record confers gating power. A fresh install gates nothing.

entities.label: Claim boundary
entities.definition: What a Scorecard can and cannot prove: it licenses only what it checked — evidence, authority, calibration, comparability, measured scope — never proof the output is correct.

entities.label: DataPolicy hard gate
entities.definition: The accepted egress set is exactly {permitted, redacted}; any other value blocks an otherwise-authorized gate. Checked egress-before-effects.

entities.label: Deletion-invariance
entities.definition: Removing the plugin, agent, or any optional lane leaves the required suite green and verdicts byte-identical.

entities.label: Evidence Approval governance
entities.definition: In-code rules preventing self-approval: synthetic forced proposed, annotations need a signed validation_record, benchmarks cannot self-approve.

entities.label: Host-owned authority
entities.definition: Gating power originates only from host-owned records; the framework reads them, never writes its own gold or approves its own thresholds.

entities.label: Local-first
entities.definition: Runs on the developer's machine and in CI — no hosted platform, no API keys, no telemetry; the repo stays the source of truth.

entities.label: Measurement state
entities.definition: Status (does a number exist?) is orthogonal to validity (can it be trusted?); only scored+valid enters aggregation.

entities.label: No false confidence / no false green
entities.definition: A run reports only what it actually measured given the host's evidence and authority — never more correctness, safety, certification, comparability, or calibration than it has earned.

entities.label: No-0.0 rule
entities.definition: A missing/untrusted measurement is recorded as null with a Diagnostic, never coerced to 0.0; Score rejects NaN/±inf/bool.

entities.label: Runtime independence
entities.definition: The verdict depends only on host config and evidence, so removing either plugin (Claude or Codex) yields byte-identical verdicts.

entities.label: Four-state status taxonomy
entities.definition: now / next / planned / experimental — the spine that keeps the deliberately-ahead-of-code site honest.

entities.label: System boundary
entities.definition: Four ownership layers give exactly one place to decide a verdict and prevent authority leaking into the framework.

entities.label: Three-stage authority ladder
entities.definition: Fail-closed per-metric resolution: not-authorized→informational; authorized-but-unsound→blocked; fully-authorized→can_gate. Typed reason codes.

entities.label: Worst-source authority
entities.definition: Across multiple inputs the weakest dataset status and least-permissive policy win, so a strong source cannot mask a weak one.

entities.label: AggregatedMetric
entities.definition: The reduced value + included_count + status_counts for one metric; empty is null, never 0.0.

entities.label: CalibrationRecord
entities.definition: Host-signed judge calibration (approver, rationale, variance over ≥2 runs) that lifts a judge to gating-eligible.

entities.label: ComparableRunFingerprint
entities.definition: The gating-dimension subset used for fail-closed baseline comparability.

entities.label: Diagnostic
entities.definition: Structured reason on every non-perfect result (code, severity, message, location, cause, evidence_refs). Never silent.

entities.label: EvalUnit
entities.definition: Intermediate convergence unit between a raw trace and an Example.

entities.label: EvidenceBundle
entities.definition: Typed effect-seam data evaluators consume; built by the Runner, vendor objects dropped at the edge.

entities.label: Example
entities.definition: The converged unit of evaluation the Core sees (input/output/expected/evidence).

entities.label: LaneResult
entities.definition: An extension lane's outcome (ran/skipped/blocked) + evidence/diagnostics — never authority or a verdict.

entities.label: ResolvedAuthority
entities.definition: Per-metric authority outcome (can_gate, level, typed reason codes) from the three-stage ladder.

entities.label: RunFingerprint
entities.definition: Ten SHA-256 dimension hashes; the six gating dimensions decide comparability.

entities.label: RunRecord
entities.definition: The complete reproducible record: run_id, embedded scorecard, all per-example Scores, RunFingerprint, comparability. Round-trips or refuses malformed input.

entities.label: RuntimeConfig
entities.definition: The typed parse of evalglass.yaml: metrics, datasets, traces, judges, thresholds, baseline, metric_status, threshold_approval.

entities.label: Score / ScoreBatch
entities.definition: Per-example result separating status from validity; enforces the no-0.0 rule; rejects NaN/inf/bool. Carries optional example_id/unit_id provenance.

entities.label: Scorecard
entities.definition: The authoritative bounded-claim structure: VerdictPayload, ci_should_fail, per-metric value/status_counts + ResolvedAuthority, baseline_state, diagnostics.

entities.label: TraceEnvelope
entities.definition: The normalized exported-trace wrapper the Runner converges into EvalUnits.

entities.label: validation_record
entities.definition: Reviewer-signed record that converts informational annotation evidence into authority evidence.

entities.label: VerdictPayload
entities.definition: Complete verdict with passed/failed/blocked/informational gate lists; re-derives itself in __post_init__ and fails closed on tampering.

entities.label: Authority
entities.definition: The per-metric outcome of the three-stage authority ladder.

entities.label: BaselineState
entities.definition: The typed comparability claim.

entities.label: DataPolicy
entities.definition: The egress data policy on an authority input; the hard gate accepts only {permitted, redacted} — any other value blocks an otherwise-authorized gate.

entities.label: DatasetStatus
entities.definition: The dataset asset state.

entities.label: ExitClass
entities.definition: The fixed verdict→exit mapping.

entities.label: MetricStatus
entities.definition: The metric asset state machine.

entities.label: ScoreStatus
entities.definition: Does a number exist for this example?

entities.label: Validity
entities.definition: Can the measurement be trusted?

entities.label: Verdict
entities.definition: The four outcomes from the single decide_verdict path.

entities.label: Annotation workflow (UI)
entities.definition: Routes uncertain examples to human review; authority only with a signed validation_record.

entities.label: Hosted dashboard sink
entities.definition: Read-only outward copy of the Scorecard for browsing; deletable, no telemetry, repo stays source of truth.

entities.label: Live-judge lane
entities.definition: Real-provider judge via stdlib urllib (no SDK); off by default; the required path uses the deterministic FakeJudgeModel.

entities.label: Live-trace connectors (Langfuse/Phoenix/LangSmith)
entities.definition: Opt-in deletable input lane for live pulls; no provider SDK on the required path; observes a recording, never orchestrates.

entities.label: Local-file dashboard sink
entities.definition: Read-only Scorecard export to a local dir; a failed publish becomes LaneResult BLOCKED and cannot change the verdict.

entities.label: Metrics explorer
entities.definition: UI for clusters/deltas/distributions beyond one flat number per metric.

entities.label: Prompt-optimizer hand-off
entities.definition: Read-only export of a Scorecard to an external optimizer; EvalGlass never auto-tunes.

entities.label: Synthetic-data generator (connect --synth)
entities.definition: Future example generation; ingests through the same proposed-forcing path the governance already enforces.

entities.label: Visual baseline-comparison view
entities.definition: Standalone delta visualization atop the CLI compare/baseline path.

entities.label: Byte-identical verdicts across runtimes
entities.definition: Claude and Codex runtimes, and the plugin-removed CLI, produce byte-identical artifacts.

entities.label: ci_should_fail = fail OR blocked
entities.definition: The only quality signal CI acts on is fixed by the Verdict Engine as (verdict is fail OR blocked).

entities.label: Core isolation (stdlib-only)
entities.definition: The Evaluation Core imports only the standard library; no I/O, clocks, randomness, subprocesses, or model calls. CI-enforced; CODEOWNERS-guarded.

entities.label: Deletion-invariance is tested
entities.definition: Removing plugin/agent/lanes is verified (not promised) to leave verdicts byte-identical and the required suite green.

entities.label: Egress before effects
entities.definition: The data-policy egress check runs before any subprocess or judge call.

entities.label: Fail-closed comparability
entities.definition: An absent provenance dimension is treated as changed; no delta is claimed across incomparable runs.

entities.label: A fresh install gates nothing
entities.definition: authority.json is empty by default, so a first run is informational and cannot fail a build.

entities.label: Incomplete cannot gate
entities.definition: A metric with excluded/incomplete measurement (excluded_count>0) cannot pass an active gate — it blocks.

entities.label: Lanes carry no authority
entities.definition: An extension lane returns evidence/diagnostics only — never a score, authority, or verdict.

entities.label: No gate/approve/certify verb exists
entities.definition: There is deliberately no verb that grants authority; promotion is a host-owned YAML/authority edit.

entities.label: No self-approval
entities.definition: SyntheticDataset is forced proposed; annotations need a signed validation_record; approve_threshold_from_benchmark() always raises GovernanceError.

entities.label: No-0.0 enforced at construction
entities.definition: Score construction records missing measurements as null+Diagnostic and rejects NaN/±inf/bool.

entities.label: Verdict tamper-rejection
entities.definition: VerdictPayload re-derives itself on construction and fails closed if its fields are tampered with.

entities.label: Agent / Operator Surface
entities.definition: Entry points that scaffold and explain but never compute or grant a verdict.

entities.label: Contracts & Host-Owned Authority
entities.definition: The typed schemas every layer speaks and the host-owned records that are the sole origin of gating power.

entities.label: Evaluation Core
entities.definition: Turns typed evidence into a deterministic verdict with zero effects. The single place an outcome is decided.

entities.label: Host Layout
entities.definition: The physical managed / host-owned split inside the user repo; managed region sealed and deletion-invariant.

entities.label: Lane Architecture
entities.definition: How any extension attaches without gaining authority: typed ports, opt-in, deletable, evidence-only.

entities.label: Lifecycle & Gating
entities.definition: Install through gate, and safe runtime upgrades.

entities.label: The Six-Step Loop
entities.definition: The recurring human+agent operating model the agent drives on the developer's behalf.

entities.label: Positioning & Creed
entities.definition: The honesty spine binding framework and site; what EvalGlass is, who it serves, and the promise that bounds every claim.

entities.label: Runtime Harness
entities.definition: Owns all side effects; converges inputs through ports; enforces the input-edge trust properties. Grants no meaning.

entities.label: DatasetStore
entities.definition: Effect seam supplying host-owned example datasets.

entities.label: JudgeModel
entities.definition: Effect seam producing judge evidence (never a score).

entities.label: ResultStore
entities.definition: Effect seam persisting Scorecard / RunRecord.

entities.label: ScoreSink
entities.definition: Effect seam rendering / exporting the immutable Scorecard.

entities.label: TaskRunner
entities.definition: Effect seam replaying the subject app to produce outputs.

entities.label: TraceSource
entities.definition: Effect seam supplying exported behavior traces.

entities.label: Adoption lifecycle (install → gate)
entities.definition: How a check moves from informational to enforced in CI, and how the runtime is upgraded safely.

entities.label: CI gating
entities.definition: The vendored runtime runs in CI and the build fails only after a host-approved gate produces fail or blocked.

entities.label: Compare / baseline
entities.definition: Resolve comparability via fingerprint match on the six gating dimensions; deltas only when comparable; baseline update promotes a baseline.

entities.label: Promote-a-gate
entities.definition: The deliberate four-precondition host edit (validated dataset, approved threshold, metric_status: gating, calibrated judge) that activates a gate. No verb grants authority.

entities.label: Revendor-safely
entities.definition: setup --upgrade → revendor --dry-run (host-patch guard) → --confirm; managed files update, host-owned truth byte-identical.

entities.label: run_evaluation pipeline
entities.definition: Normalize → Measure → Aggregate & Qualify → Decide & Emit — the effect-free Core pipeline.

entities.label: The six-step loop
entities.definition: Ask → Observe → Shape → Run → Read → Improve — the recurring operating model.

entities.label: CI integration (gate)
entities.definition: Workflow acts on ci_should_fail / exit code only.

entities.label: Compare / baseline
entities.definition: Show deltas only when typed comparable; promote a baseline explicitly.

entities.label: Connect
entities.definition: Supply exported traces; normalized at the edge.

entities.label: Install / setup / vendor
entities.definition: Vendor the runtime with manifest+lock; scaffold proposed assets.

entities.label: Promote-a-gate
entities.definition: Four-precondition host YAML/authority edit; no verb grants authority.

entities.label: Revendor-safely
entities.definition: dry-run + confirm; managed files update, host truth byte-identical.

entities.label: Run (informational first)
entities.definition: A fresh install gates nothing; the first run is informational.

entities.label: Shape & validate checks
entities.definition: Scaffold metrics/judges; calibrate; host validates datasets.

entities.label: Ask
entities.definition: State in natural language what changed.

entities.label: Improve
entities.definition: Fix prompts/models, validate data, calibrate judges, or promote a gate.

entities.label: Observe
entities.definition: Read repo, prompts, call sites (read-only), traces, examples.

entities.label: Read
entities.definition: Explain values, deltas (if comparable), authority, diagnostics, unknowns.

entities.label: Run
entities.definition: Evaluate locally; score, resolve comparability then authority, decide once.

entities.label: Shape
entities.definition: Scaffold metrics/judges/rubrics/scenarios — all proposed/informational.

entities.label: Aggregate & Qualify
entities.definition: Reduce scored+valid Scores; resolve comparability then authority.

entities.label: Decide & Emit
entities.definition: decide_verdict runs once; pack Scorecard + RunRecord.

entities.label: Measure
entities.definition: Evaluators produce Scores (status×validity, no-0.0).

entities.label: Normalize
entities.definition: Receive typed Examples + EvidenceBundle (vendor objects already dropped).

entities.label: /evalglass add-judge
entities.definition: Scaffold a judge metric (informational until calibrated).

entities.label: /evalglass add-metric
entities.definition: Scaffold a non-authoritative metric (lands proposed/informational).

entities.label: /evalglass baseline
entities.definition: Promote a baseline (baseline update) with gating-dimension fingerprints.

entities.label: /evalglass calibrate
entities.definition: Run judge calibration against host labels and write a CalibrationRecord.

entities.label: /evalglass ci
entities.definition: Scaffold / drive the CI workflow that acts on ci_should_fail only.

entities.label: /evalglass compare
entities.definition: Resolve comparability and show deltas only when typed comparable.

entities.label: /evalglass connect
entities.definition: Supply exported traces; normalized at the edge, no SDK/network.

entities.label: /evalglass explain
entities.definition: Explain values, deltas, per-metric authority, diagnostics, unknowns.

entities.label: /evalglass run
entities.definition: Evaluate locally and produce a Scorecard + RunRecord.

entities.label: /evalglass setup
entities.definition: Vendor the runtime, discover call sites read-only, scaffold proposed assets.

entities.label: /evalglass view
entities.definition: Render a Scorecard (incl. the --by-call per example/unit view).
